summary: Five plugins track selected options, search evidence, purchase readiness, price evidence, and bounded budget-aware search recovery. L5 adoption targets strict success rather than partial shopping reward.

responsibilities.option-ledger: Track real option selections and outstanding requested specifications.
responsibilities.search-evidence: Use visible search/product evidence for candidate comparison.
responsibilities.checkout-loop: Control premature or repeated checkout attempts.
responsibilities.price-evidence: Check visible price against the user budget.
responsibilities.budget-search: At most one bounded alternative click after an explicitly over-budget choice.
